\begin{example} \end{example}[Characteristics for the Hamilton--Jacobi equation] ↗ thm:characteristic-ode-structure 1. ch3:3.2-ex-6\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

For $u_t+H(Du,x)=0$, the characteristic system is \[ \dot p=-D_xH(p,x),\qquad \dot z=D_pH(p,x)\cdot p-H(p,x),\qquad \dot x=D_pH(p,x). \] The first and third equations are Hamilton's equations. \end{example}
